name: New Advanced Electronics Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: New Advanced Electronics Technologies Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, production, and distribution of a wide array of audio equipment and power solutions, serving markets in the United States, Japan, Canada, and Germany. The company's extensive product line encompasses various speaker types, including powered, bookshelf, surround sound, in-wall/in-ceiling, outdoor, and wireless models, as well as floor-standing units, center channel speakers, home theater systems, tweeters, transducers, amplifiers, crossovers, and LCR systems. Complementing these are their portable power supplies and chargers. Founded in 1993 under the name Samya Technology Co., Ltd., the organization rebranded to New Advanced Electronics Technologies Co., Ltd. in November 2018 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
